skill.name: self-improving-agent
skill.description: Capture skill outcomes as structured memory and proposals, then promote validated improvements with approval controls.
skill.summary: Turn repeated skill feedback into traceable, evidence-gated improvement proposals.
skill.author: charon-fan

security_audit.summary: Static findings are predominantly false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline backticks, research links, and documentation of local paths. The bundled hook scripts only log event metadata and output lengths; they do not perform network requests, command interpolation, or memory writes. The documented automatic memory workflow still needs privacy controls because it can retain context from many skill events.

remediation.issue: Automatic learning can retain sensitive task context across skill events.
remediation.suggestion: Document data minimization, consent, retention limits, and a simple way to inspect and delete memory artifacts before enabling automatic hooks.

remediation.issue: Manual hook examples execute local shell scripts.
remediation.suggestion: Keep hook paths fixed and trusted, preserve argument quoting, and instruct users to review the installed skill directory before enabling hooks.

semantic_findings.title: Automatic cross-skill memory collection may retain sensitive task context
semantic_findings.description: The skill describes automatic capture of experiences from all skill events and memory artifacts, but does not define data minimization, retention, or consent controls. Users may record task details or tool-related context in a persistent local memory store.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documentation explicitly states universal event learning and identifies persistent semantic, episodic, and working memory locations. It does not specify a retention or sensitive-data exclusion policy.

content.value_statement: Repeated workflow lessons can be lost or applied without enough evidence. This skill captures structured experiences and creates traceable proposals before durable guidance changes.
actual_capabilities: Captures structured outcomes, feedback, and lessons from skill workflows.
Organizes reusable knowledge into semantic, episodic, and working memory concepts.
Creates evidence-based proposals for skill, documentation, or code improvements.
Tracks pattern confidence and repeated applications before broad promotion.
Provides optional hook examples for session and tool event logging.
limitations: It cannot prove that a proposed improvement is correct without tests or review.
Automatic memory collection may retain sensitive task context unless users set local policies.
Hook behavior depends on host runtime support and local configuration.
It does not replace user approval for durable guidance, repository rule, or runtime changes.

use_cases.title: Maintain team playbooks
use_cases.description: Turn recurring support and review lessons into traceable proposals for shared skill guidance.

use_cases.title: Learn from debugging sessions
use_cases.description: Record verified root causes and promote repeated debugging patterns after review.

use_cases.title: Review agent workflows
use_cases.description: Collect feedback signals and validate proposed changes before updating agent instructions.

prompt_templates.title: Capture one lesson
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this completed workflow. Extract one verified lesson, its evidence, and a safe proposal for future use.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize feedback
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize these user feedback notes into episodic memories. Separate facts from assumptions and assign confidence.

prompt_templates.title: Compare recurring patterns
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these episodes. Identify patterns that recur, explain the supporting evidence, and propose only low-risk guidance updates.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an approval-ready proposal
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a proposal to improve this skill. Include affected files, evidence, validation steps, rollback notes, and ask for approval before durable edits.

output_examples.input: A debugging workflow found an empty refresh callback in three separate incidents.
output: Pattern: verify callback implementations before release.
Evidence: three documented incidents with the same root cause.
Next step: propose a debugger checklist update and validate it with a focused test.

output_examples.input: A user reports that a generated deployment guide was incomplete.
output: Episode: deployment guide omitted rollback verification.
Confidence: low until the guide is reproduced and reviewed.
Proposal: add a rollback checklist only after validation.

best_practices: Capture facts separately from interpretations and record supporting evidence.
Promote durable changes only after validation or explicit user approval.
Review stored memory regularly and remove sensitive or outdated artifacts.
anti_patterns: Do not generalize a single incident into a permanent rule.
Do not overwrite skills, repository rules, or runtime code without approval and validation.
Do not store credentials, private data, or unnecessary tool output in memory artifacts.

faq.question: What does this skill improve?
faq.answer: It helps convert verified workflow lessons into memory artifacts and improvement proposals.

faq.question: Does it edit skills automatically?
faq.answer: It should capture proposals first. Durable guidance changes require validation or explicit approval.

faq.question: What information can it store?
faq.answer: It can store structured lessons, outcomes, feedback, and proposed improvements. Avoid sensitive data.

faq.question: Are hooks required?
faq.answer: No. Hooks are optional and depend on the host runtime and local configuration.

faq.question: How are patterns promoted?
faq.answer: Patterns should recur or be validated by focused tests or reviews before promotion.

faq.question: Can I remove stored learning data?
faq.answer: Yes. Review and delete local memory artifacts according to your retention policy.
